participant_id.Description: BIDS subject label; equal to the DANDI subject label (Pt01-Pt03, the three successful recordings of the article).

age.Description: Not given per participant by the source (NWB age is the cohort range P34Y/P75Y).

sex.Description: Not given per participant by the source (NWB sex 'U'; the article cohort of 9 had 7 females).

age_range_cohort.Description: NWB general/subject/age verbatim: ISO 8601 range covering the whole 9-participant cohort (34-75 years), not the individual age.

anesthesia_state.Description: State during the recording (Dryad release methods).

procedure.Description: Surgical procedure during which the recording was made (Dryad release methods).

recorded_area.Description: Cortical area of the probe insertion (Dryad release methods).
